title: Never Ending Cairo Market
description: Revitalizing Cairo's 1912 Bab al-Luq market with optimized circulation and a parametric roof of computationally controlled openings.
body: The market is reorganized as a multi-level shopping environment driven by circulation: differential-growth principles generate smooth, fluid pathways connecting the four primary entrances, with two paths displacing vertically into ramps that link the ground floor to the upper levels and storage tucked beneath. The traditional Cairo tessellation is reconstructed parametrically and settled through dynamic relaxation in Kangaroo.

Above, a parametric roof turns the initially flat surface into a highly expressive structure. A heat-map proximity analysis of the flows below controls the roof's deformation, frame sizing and openings, so the light and shadow patterns cast into the market are strategically aligned with the movement beneath.

sections.title: Design Concept
body: Two computational principles carry the whole scheme. Differential growth generates the circulation and drives the roof; the traditional Cairo tessellation, reconstructed parametrically, defines the roof modules.

sections.title: Computational Design Methodology
body: The circulation layout is the input everything else derives from — pathways settle through dynamic relaxation, then feed the roof's deformation, frame sizing and openings.

sections.title: Form Iterations
body: Varying the growth parameters produces a family of circulation geometries, each compared for how the resulting paths connect the four entrances.

sections.title: Form Finding Process
body: Seven steps take the roof from a flat surface to its final form: the Cairo tessellation is applied, frame sizes varied, and points displaced in Z — then the circulation heat map drives both the frame sizing and the point movement, so the openings above line up with the flows beneath.

sections.title: Exploded View
body: The intervention separated into its three layers — the new roof carrying the Cairo tessellation, the support structure beneath it, and the existing 1912 market it sits over.

sections.title: Drawings
body: The market resolved across levels, with the roof reading as a single continuous surface over the restored historic shell.
